1. (Currently amended) A golf tee comprising a long lasting combination of a golf tee and a force absorbing member in association therewith, said tee including a ground insertion end, a ball support end and a shaft in between, said member surrounding said shaft and being located below said ball support end and having an outer diameter less than that of a golf ball but large enough and located so as to protect said support end from impact from a golf club strike after a golf ball has been struck from said tee, wherein said force absorbing member is __permanently affixed to said shaft__.

2. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 1, wherein said tee is formed from a material that enables the shaft to withstand damage from a strike on the resilient member __and wherein said force absorbing member is formed from a material different from the material of said tee__.

3. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 1, wherein said tee is formed from a member selected from the group consisting of wood, plastic and metal, __and wherein said force absorbing member is formed from rubber or elastomer__.

4. (Original) The golf tee of claim 3, wherein said tee is formed from a hardwood.

5. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 3, wherein said tee is formed from an engineering plastic __selected from polycarbonate or nylon, and wherein said force absorbing member comprises a rubber or elastomer material__.

6. (Original) The golf tee of claim 5, wherein said tee is formed from a polycarbonate.

7. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 3, wherein said tee is formed from nylon, __and wherein said force absorbing member comprises a rubber or elastomer material__.

8. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 3, wherein said tee is formed from a malleable metal __and wherein said force absorbing member is formed from rubber or elastomer__.

9. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 8, wherein said tee is formed from aluminum __and wherein said force absorbing member is permanently affixed to the shaft__.

10. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 9, wherein said force absorbing member is formed from a force absorbing material comprising a natural or man-made material __that is distinct from aluminum__.

11. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 1, wherein said force absorbing member is formed from a force absorbing material comprising a natural or man-made material __that is bonded or adhered to said shaft__.

12. (Original) The golf tee of claim 11, wherein said force absorbing material has a hardness of from about 30 to about 90 durometer.

13. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 12, wherein said force absorbing material comprises a neoprene having a hardness of from about 50 to about 60 durometer __and wherein said neoprene is chemically bonded to said shaft__.

14. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 11, wherein said force absorbing material comprises a neoprene __that is chemically bonded to said shaft__.
